entities.name: Ethyl ester substrate
observations: Formula reported from RDKit decoding: C14H15NO3.

entities.name: Amino acid product
observations: Under basic conditions, the corresponding sodium carboxylate predominates before acidification.

entities.name: Ester saponification
observations: Methanol/water with NaOH converts the ethyl ester group CCOC(=O) to the carboxylic acid/carboxylate group while retaining the amide and alkyne.
The matching record supports ester hydrolysis rather than aerobic alkyne oxidation.
